claim: Kinesis Data Streams for DynamoDB supports up to 5 simultaneous consumers per shard, or up to 20 with enhanced fan-out. DynamoDB Streams supports up to 2 simultaneous consumers per shard.
question: How many simultaneous consumers per shard do Kinesis Data Streams and DynamoDB Streams support?

qualifiers.condition: Kinesis Data Streams: 5, or 20 with enhanced fan-out; DynamoDB Streams: 2
